rules: Cancellation propagates to the provider request and persists the CANCELLED state.
Timeouts are bounded and produce a visible partial-failure state.
No provider secret or raw source text appears in the stream metadata.
A streamed assistant draft is never labeled COMPLETED until stream.complete persists the message.
Every displayed citation resolves to an authorized chunk and document at access time.
A citation whose source lost access shows an unavailable-source state, never the content.
Historical citations are reauthorized when opened.
A no-answer or low-confidence query returns an honest no-answer state with a safe reason code.
No-answer is never presented as a successful generation.
The no-answer reason code is one of NO_MATCH, LOW_CONFIDENCE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, CANCELLED.
The deterministic CI provider is used for all automated tests; live provider smoke is separate and labeled with model, version and date.
Provider output is untrusted data and never higher-priority instructions.
The provider receives only minimal authorized context.
Raw prompts and source text are denied at default log, trace and metric ingestion.
Traces record safe IDs, hashes, counts and outcomes only.
Raw prompt, context and source text are disabled from default traces.
Retention is 30 days for redacted metadata; aggregate quality metrics may live 180 days.
Trace inspection requires tenant admin authorization and is cross-tenant denied.
Sessions and messages are owned by tenant plus subject; every read, write, export and delete reauthorizes that ownership.
Sending is idempotent via clientMessageId scoped to session plus subject.
Regenerate creates a new revision linked through parentMessageId; the prior revision is preserved.
Pagination uses stable cursors; deleted messages disappear from history after propagation.
Default retention is 90 days for completed sessions; canceled or failed drafts are diagnostic-retained for 7 days.

securityInvariants: Authorization filters run during retrieval and are rechecked before context assembly.
Unauthorized candidates or context reaching provider construction is a STOP.
Sources are untrusted data and never higher-priority instructions.
Session and message ownership is tenant plus subject scoped and reauthorized on every access path.
A streaming, canceled or failed assistant draft is never labeled completed.
